### Types

The types the tables below name, from `identity/domain.ts`:

```ts
type IdentityKind = "person" | "service" | "process";

type IdentityStatus = "none" | "active" | "suspended" | "deleted";

interface Scope { type: string; id: string }

interface Membership {
  membershipId: string;
  group: string;
  scope: Scope | null;
  expiresAt: number | null;
  status: "active" | "suspended";
}

interface ApiKey { keyId: string; hash: string; label: string; expiresAt: number | null; revoked: boolean }
```

### Aggregates

| Aggregate | Unique keys | Facts |
|---|---|---|
| `identity.identity` | `account`, `process` | `active` |

### Commands

Secret fields leave the vault once the command completes; personal fields stay in the vault until their subject is erased.

| Command | Fields | Writes | Who may send it | Refused with |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CreateApiKey`<br>on `identity` | `keyId: string`<br>`secret: string` (secret)<br>`label?: string`<br>`expiresAt?: number \| null` | `ApiKeyCreated` | a group permission | `exists`, `invalid_key`, `invalid_state`, `not_a_service` |
| `CreateServiceIdentity`<br>on `identity` | `displayName: string` (personal) | `IdentityCreated` | a group permission | `exists`, `invalid_name` |
| `CreateProcessIdentity`<br>on `identity` | `process: string` | `IdentityCreated` | only the kit's reactors | `exists`, `invalid_process` |
| `CreateIdentity`<br>on `identity` | `accountId: string`<br>`displayName?: string` (personal)<br>`title?: string` (personal)<br>`email?: string` (personal) | `IdentityCreated` | only the kit's reactors | `exists`, `invalid_account` |
| `DeleteIdentity`<br>on `identity` | — | `IdentityDeleted` | a group permission, or the sender itself | `not_found`; requires: no tenancy.tenant holds it as owner |
| `GrantMembership`<br>on `identity` | `membershipId: string`<br>`group: string`<br>`scope?: Scope \| null`<br>`expiresAt?: number \| null` | `MembershipGranted` | a group permission; only with permissions the sender holds | `exists`, `invalid_membership`, `invalid_scope`, `invalid_state`; requires: group.group is active |
| `ReactivateIdentity`<br>on `identity` | — | `IdentityReactivated` | a group permission | `invalid_state` |
| `ResumeMembership`<br>on `identity` | `membershipId: string` | `MembershipResumed` | a group permission | `not_found` |
| `RevokeApiKey`<br>on `identity` | `keyId: string` | `ApiKeyRevoked` | a group permission | `not_found` |
| `RevokeMembership`<br>on `identity` | `membershipId: string` | `MembershipRevoked` | a group permission | `not_found` |
| `SuspendMembership`<br>on `identity` | `membershipId: string` | `MembershipSuspended` | a group permission | `not_found` |
| `SuspendIdentity`<br>on `identity` | `reason?: string` | `IdentitySuspended` | a group permission | `invalid_state` |
| `UpdateProfile`<br>on `identity` | `displayName?: string` (personal)<br>`title?: string` (personal)<br>`email?: string` (personal) | `ProfileUpdated` | a group permission, or the sender itself | `invalid_state` |

### Queries

A query about one aggregate names it (`static target`): the middleware decides on that aggregate as on a command's.

| Query | Fields | About | Answer | Who may ask |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FindIdentityByAccount`<br>by `identity.identities` | `accountId: string` | — | `{ identityId: string; status: IdentityStatus }` | the API (its `api` group) |
| `GetIdentity`<br>by `identity.identities` | `identityId: string` | `identity.identity` in `identityId` | `IdentityRow { id, tenant, kind, accountId, displayName, status, memberships, apiKeys }` | a group permission, or the sender itself |
| `ListMyIdentities`<br>by `identity.identities` | `accountId: string` | `account.account` in `accountId` | `{ tenant: string; identityId: string; status: IdentityStatus }[]` | any signed-in account, or the sender itself |
| `ListIdentities`<br>by `identity.identities` | — | — | `IdentityRow[]` | a group permission |
| `FindApiKey`<br>by `identity.identities` | `keyId: string` | — | `{ tenant: string; identityId: string; hash: string; expiresAt: number \| null; revoked: boolean }` | the API (its `api` group) |
